Orioles Sweep Blue Jays, Ending Toronto's Playoff Hopes

The Baltimore Orioles swept a doubleheader against the Toronto Blue Jays, ending the Blue Jays' playoff aspirations. The Orioles' victories kept their own playoff hopes alive. The Blue Jays' season, which saw them fall from World Series runner-up status, is described as a 'heartbreaking' end.
